headline: Russian Diesel Shipments Head to US Following Bilateral Agreement
summary: Data shows shipments of Russian diesel are heading to the United States following a bilateral arrangement between Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump.
why: Energy flows between Russia and Western nations have been heavily constrained by sanctions. Direct diesel shipments represent a significant shift in refined fuel supply dynamics and sanction enforcement.

impacts.name: Heating Oil / Diesel
impacts.why: Incoming imported supply of refined diesel puts downward pressure on domestic distillate fuel prices.
